method: independent: own loader + plane-fitted part frame; per-5mm perpendicular sections fit outer/inner skins, virtual sharps, outer apex; gold expressed as (u,v) depth from wall / face-flange outer planes. Light numpy only (no engine/bench runs, no lock needed).
part_geometry: rectangular box frame ~314x208x42 mm, t~1.4-1.5 mm, R_outer~2.4-2.8 mm: continuous top frame face (window) + 4 walls; C-section on all sides; short sides have ~12 mm bottom flanges; long sides have ~35 mm bottom flanges each with a full-length ~1.9 mm joggle ~22 mm in from the wall; open relief seams at the 4 vertical corners, no tabs, no hems.

lines.fold: e1-min short side, bottom bend (wall->short flange)
lines.reason: parallel (0.19 deg), full-length, constant 4.0-4.2 mm (4.9 at corner ends) on the concave side: sits on the inner (top) skin of the short bottom flange, u~4.8 mm from the wall outer plane, ~2.2 mm past the inner tangent line. Not toward the outer virtual sharp (5.1 mm away). Just over the 4 mm matcher limit.

lines.fold: e1-max short side, bottom bend (wall->short flange)
lines.reason: parallel (0.16 deg), full-length, constant 4.6-4.8 mm (5.3 at ends) on the concave/flange side: u~5.5 mm from the wall outer plane inside the flange thickness (inner skin unscanned there), ~2.9 mm past the inner tangent. Same inside-of-bend placement as M01; larger than any canonical locus (<=2.6 mm) so it is a click-placement convention, not a mold-line one. Borderline.

lines.fold: e1-min short side, top bend (wall->frame face)
lines.reason: inner-skin locus: on the wall inner skin 0.3-1.2 mm below the inner tangent; 2.3-3.2 mm from the outer apex, parallel (0.31 deg); within the 4 mm limit over its whole length.

lines.fold: e1-max short side, top bend (wall->frame face)
lines.reason: inside the bend arc (inner side), 1.6-2.0 mm from the outer apex, parallel (0.28 deg), full length.

lines.fold: e2-min long side, top bend (wall->frame face)
lines.reason: slanted 2.37 deg: runs down the inner face of the e2-min wall from 6.4 mm to 18.4 mm below the top-face plane (d_apex 5.5-17.9, median 11.6); never within 4 mm. Endpoints sit on the inner vertical box-corner edges (1.8 mm in plan) at heights 14.7 and 3.1 vs top bend ~20: wrong pick depth.

lines.fold: e2-min long side, bottom bend (wall->joggled flange)
lines.reason: slanted 1.64 deg: starts 10.7 mm up the e2-min wall at the +e1 corner (endpoint e3=-11.0), converges to the bottom bend at the -e1 corner (d_apex 10.1 -> 1.9, median 5.9); within 4 mm on only 28% of the fold.

lines.fold: e2-max long side, top bend (wall->frame face)
lines.reason: slanted 1.63 deg: near the top bend at the +e1 corner (3.2 mm), descends to 11.7 mm below it at the -e1 corner (endpoint e3=8.9); within 4 mm on only 13% of the fold; median 6.8 mm.

lines.fold: e2-max long side, bottom bend (wall->joggled flange)
lines.reason: parallel within 0.59 deg but displaced 6.7-9.6 mm up the inner face of the e2-max wall from the bottom bend (d_apex 6.3-8.8, median 7.5), in air 0.2-1.3 mm in front of the unscanned inner skin; offset is away from both virtual sharps, so not a locus convention. Right bend identity, wrong height.
